links.outcome: Clinician adjudication of all AI-flagged candidate harm signals, including detection of unsupported outputs
links.effect: Clinicians reviewed all 237 flagged cases: 102 confirmed harm, 43 possible, 81 no harm, 11 unsupported outputs (4.6%); PPV 43.0% confirmed, 61.2% confirmed-or-possible.
links.quote: Clinicians classified 102 as confirmed iatrogenic harm, 43 as possible harm, 81 as no harm and 11 as unsupported outputs.

unlisted_practices: LLM screening of discharge summaries for treatment injury surveillance and compensation claim identification

screen.reason: Evaluates a live quality-improvement pilot deploying an LLM to screen discharge summaries for iatrogenic harm with mandatory human-in-the-loop clinician review and escalation.

primary.practice: clinician review and adjudication of AI-flagged harm signals
